margins.name: Aluminium smelter margin
margins.note: At spot power. Most smelters buy on long contracts, so this shows the pressure they are under rather than what their accounts will say.

margins.name: Spark spread
margins.note: Carbon is excluded: EUA futures have no free feed. At 0.37 t/MWh a gas plant's real spread is lower than this by the carbon price times that figure.

margins.name: Refining crack (3-2-1)
margins.note: What a refinery earns turning a barrel into fuel, and the part of a pump price that is neither crude nor tax.
